messages.author: ce197138d7df0ae3
messages.subject: Rounding Problem
parts:
I used cbind(round(xxx, 4), ...) inside renderTable(), but it only printed 2 significant digits.  Please help!
Specifically,

est_print = cbind(round(agr$Estimate$CCC,4),round(agr$Estimate$Precision,4),round(agr$Estimate$Accuracy,4), round(agr$Estimate$TDI,as.numeric(input$dec)), round(agr$Estimate$CP,4), round(agr$Estimate$RBS,2))
      conf_print = cbind(round(agr$Conf_Limit$CCC,4),round(agr$Conf_Limit$Precision,4),round(agr$Conf_Limit$Accuracy,4), round(agr$Conf_Limit$TDI,as.numeric(input$dec)), round(agr$Conf_Limit$CP,4), round(agr$Conf_Limit$RBS,2))
      allo_print = cbind(round(agr$Allowance$CCC,4),round(agr$Allowance$Precision,4),round(agr$Allowance$Accuracy,4), round(agr$Allowance$TDI,as.numeric(input$dec)), round(agr$Allowance$CP,4), round(agr$Allowance$RBS,2))
      mytable <- rbind(est_print,conf_print,allo_print) 
      colnames(mytable) <- c("CCC","Precision","Accuracy","TDI","CP","RBS")
      rownames(mytable) <- c("Statistic","95% CL","Allowance")
      myxtable <- xtable(mytable)
      myxtable

and I got
CCC Precision Accuracy TDI CP RBS
Statistic 0.99 0.99 1.00 127.49 0.95 0.00
95% CL 0.98 0.98 1.00 136.39 0.93
Allowance 0.98 150.00 0.90

myxtable <- xtable(mytable,digits=4)
